title: Brand

fields.label: Logo
fields.name: logo
fields.instructions: SVG or PNG on a transparent background. Shown on product cards, the brand page hero and the product page.

fields.label: Accent colour
fields.name: accent_colour
fields.instructions: Highlight colour for this brand (e.g. Clonex yellow #FBC707).

fields.label: Growth Technology brand
fields.name: own_brand
fields.instructions: Tick for brands formulated by Growth Technology. The shop's default sort puts these first.

fields.label: Feature in the shop grid
fields.name: promo_enabled
fields.instructions: Adds an "Explore the range" tile among the products on the shop page and on category pages where this brand has products.

fields.label: Tile image
fields.name: promo_image
fields.instructions: Portrait lifestyle shot; cropped to 322 x 439 at desktop.

fields.label: Grid position
fields.name: promo_position
fields.instructions: Which cell of the grid the tile occupies, counting from 1. The Figma uses 2 for Clonex and 7 for Root Riot.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.name: promo_tagline
fields.instructions: Wrap the highlighted words in … to colour them with the accent, e.g. The original rooting gel. A complete propagation system.
fields.placeholder: The original rooting gel. A complete propagation system.

description: Brand identity and shop promo tile. Brand landing page content is added in a later phase.
